The collision nobody saw

PR playground for #4026. The sandbox denial was the loud half. The other half could make a test pass on the wrong data.

Two defects, one line each

symptomfixed by
loudsandbox denies /tmp, 8 tests fail locally, pass in CI${TMPDIR:-/tmp}
quietfixed filenames, two concurrent runs share one file, a test can assert on another run's output and passmktemp
 
/tmp/watch-out.txt   /tmp/stamp-out.txt   /tmp/consol-1.out   /tmp/cc-triage-out.txt

$TMPDIR alone fixes only the first. It would have moved the collision from /tmp to $TMPDIR and called it done.

I wrote the acceptance criterion, and it was wrong

My own text in #4026 asked for grep -rn '/tmp/' tests/ | grep -v TMPDIR to return nothing. Following it breaks tests. Most /tmp under tests/ is fixture data:

input='{"tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"/tmp/x.txt"}}'

That never touches disk. It is a string a hook classifies. Two cases are load-bearing: one test passes a /tmp path that must not exist, and another carries a remote scp destination. The correction is posted on the issue so its text stops being a trap.

So the guard matches write shapes, and my first attempt still got it wrong

first scan flagged:
  test-permission-posttool-hooks.sh:277
  {"tool_input":{"command":"rm -rf /tmp/files"}}

An rm the test feeds to a guard as data. Matching write shapes was not sufficient on its own; fixture-marked lines had to be excluded too. That case is now control D, so the next person cannot re-simplify the rule back into flagging it.

Four controls, because a grep that matches nothing looks like a grep that is broken

green  a fixture string mentioning /tmp
green  a write shape inside a JSON fixture
red    a planted redirect to /tmp
green  the mktemp/TMPDIR form (or every file this PR fixed would re-offend)

Result

8 previously-denied tests    rc=0, denied-writes=0
guard                        5 passed, 0 failed
bash tests/unit/test-no-hardcoded-tmp-writes.sh
One of the nine, tests/unit/test-coordination-lib.sh, was already fixed inside #4045, since it is the only one pre-push actually runs.
